# Mpumelelo Mkhize — The Tech Translator

> Mpumelelo "Khabazela" Mkhize is a developer and systems builder in Johannesburg, South Africa. He turns manual chaos into working systems: websites, apps, automations and AI integrations for small businesses, teams and ministries.

## Services
- App Development
- Web App Development
- Automation
- AI Integrations

## Who it is for
Small businesses, teams and ministries (South Africa and remote worldwide) that need non-technical-friendly tools: bookings, automations, apps and websites.
